items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: I was an agent in Florida by the name of Brownie Roberts. He was out in Fort Lauderdale. Well he had wrote to me and he told me that he had about three weeks booking that he could give me right away if I could take it.

ctx.x: Do you remember when he died, the year?

No, I can't tell you the exact year off hand because I have it wrote down anyway, my cousins, they have it, but anyhow he died, I was out of town. I was out of town. And I went out of town, you see I came in and he was sick. Well he was right here at 611 Dauphin. And I went around and he was very, very little sick and I shaved him one day.

And I was living uptown and I came back two days after he was up and he had a few chickens and he was out there in the yard feeding the chickens and he was all right. And he had been very little sick and I didn't think that he was going to make it then. And so anyway, he got all right and he was up. So I went out of town because I used to go and see him, used to be down there four, sometimes five times a week. I used to come down and see him and sit down and talk.
